propositions: The session-start field-readiness gate in 9790 waits for Epic Link and Epic Name fields that are not provisioned until the first Jira Software project is created, causing a deadlock where all 62 harness cells error at fixture setup before any project can be created.

The ordering defect is budget-independent: experiment 30981084637 confirmed that 180 seconds of additional quiet time with no project action resulted in zero field changes, while creating the GreenHopper scrum project provisioned the Epic fields within 0.05 seconds.

The decision rule in not_ready_message ('zero customfield_* entries means the plugin is still starting') is incorrect for instances with no provisioned projects and has caused repeated misdiagnosis pointing readers at the budget rather than the ordering problem.

The fix relocates the capability guard from session-start (wait_for_jira_dc_ready) to immediately after project provisioning (_assert_project_capabilities), keeping the guard but moving it to a call site where the precondition can actually be satisfied.
The probe script jira_dc_epic_link_clear_probe.py has the same ordering bug: it calls await_required_fields before creating its project, preventing it from passing since change 1387.
